Done. I updated src/lru.ts to add optional TTL support and a testable now() hook:

Summary of changes
- Constructor now accepts an options object: new LRUCache(capacity, { ttl?: number, now?: () => number }).
  - ttl (ms) is the default TTL for entries; if omitted, entries never expire.
  - now defaults to Date.now and is used to compute expiry timestamps (helps testing).
- set(key, value, ttlMs?) accepts an optional per-entry ttlMs which overrides the default TTL for that entry. If no TTL is provided for an entry (neither per-entry nor default), the entry never expires.
- Expired entries behave as if they were never present:
  - get returns undefined and has returns false for expired entries.
  - size and keys() exclude expired entries.
  - delete returns false for expired entries (as if they weren't present).
- When inserting into a full cache, expired entries are removed first; if still full, the oldest live entry is evicted.
- get refreshes recency for live entries; has does not.

I ran the existing tests; they all pass (7 passed). If you want, I can add unit tests covering TTL behavior and the now() hook.
